fields.g: 2020 census tract GEOID (11 digits; Connecticut uses 2022+ planning-region county codes)
fields.geom: MultiPolygon coordinates: [polygon[ring[[lon,lat],...]]], simplified (meta.simplify_deg), rounded to meta.decimals
fields.m.income: ACS B19013 median household income, USD (2024 inflation-adjusted)
fields.m.home_value: ACS B25077 median value, owner-occupied units, USD
fields.m.year_built: ACS B25035 median year structure built (1939 = 1939 or earlier)
fields.m.owner_pct: ACS B25003 owner-occupied / occupied housing units, percent
fields.m.sf_pct: ACS B25024 1-unit detached / all housing units, percent
fields.m.oz18: 1 = at least half of the tract's land area lies in 2018-round Qualified Opportunity Zones (in force to 2028-12-31)
fields.m.nri_flood: FEMA NRI flood risk score: max of riverine (IFLD) and coastal (CFLD) risk scores (0-100)
fields.m.hpi_1y: FHFA tract HPI annual change, latest year, percent
fields.m.hpi_5y: FHFA tract HPI change over 5 years to the latest year, percent
